name: textdata
tagline: Edit config files in Go without losing a single comment.
description: Comment- and byte-preserving parsers and editors for .env (dotenv) and JSONC/JSON config files in Go. Parse, read, change one value and save: every comment, blank line, key order and quote you did not touch is written back exactly. Stdlib only, fuzz-tested, with ${VAR} expansion, secret plugins (gopass, Vault, AWS) and a CLI.

positioning.category: Lossless config file editing for Go
positioning.audience: Go developers whose tools read and rewrite config files that people also edit by hand
positioning.wedge: Round-trip fidelity. Parse(x).Render() == x for every input, and an edit changes only the bytes it touches, so a tool can update one key in a committed .env or JSONC file without reformatting it or dropping comments.
differentiators: Byte-exact round trip for every input, valid or not, pinned by fuzz tests
Edits touch only their own bytes: comments, order, quoting and line endings survive
Standard library only in the base and format modules
One expansion engine and one plugin seam across dotenv and JSONC
Secrets from gopass, files, HashiCorp Vault and AWS through opt-in plugin modules
A CLI (textdatactl) with a JSON envelope and stable exit codes
